
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/manyeyes/p/19153890" title="发布于 2025-10-20 23:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr 使用指南</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-first-child="">一、简介</h2>
<p data-pid="CCvjSfEh">ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr 是&nbsp;<a class=" wrap external" href="https://github.com/manyeyes/ManySpeech" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow">ManySpeech</a>&nbsp;语音处理套件中一个专门用于<em>moonshine&nbsp;</em>模型推理的语音识别组件，其使用 c# 开发，底层调用 Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 对 onnx 模型进行解码。具备以下特点：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pid="km4e5Rz7">环境兼容性：支持 net461+、net60+、netcoreapp3.1 以及 netstandard2.0+ 等多种环境，能适配不同开发场景需求。</li>
<li data-pid="Sk6koN25">跨平台编译特性：支持跨平台编译，可应用于 Windows 7 SP1 及更高版本、macOS 10.13（High Sierra）及更高版本（也支持 iOS 等）、Linux 发行版（需满足特定依赖关系，详见.NET 6 支持的 Linux 发行版列表）以及 Android 5.0（API 21）及更高版本等平台。</li>
<li data-pid="MtLq1nkk">支持 AOT 编译：使用起来简单方便，便于开发者快速集成到项目中。</li>
</ul>
<h2>二、安装方式</h2>
<p data-pid="e-4a_ptQ">推荐通过 NuGet 包管理器进行安装，以下是两种具体的安装途径：</p>
<h3>（一）使用 Package Manager Console</h3>
<p data-pid="Wxafrsi-">在 Visual Studio 的「Package Manager Console」中执行以下命令：</p>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">Install-Package ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr </code></pre>
</div>
<h3>（二）使用.NET CLI</h3>
<p data-pid="u6M-gFfk">在命令行中输入以下命令来安装：</p>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">dotnet add package ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr </code></pre>
</div>
<h3>（三）示例项目介绍</h3>
<ol>
<li data-pid="o8lKcuam">使用方式示例&nbsp;使用 vs2022（或其他 IDE）加载项目，并运行 ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Examples，有以下三种使用方式：</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">// 三种使用方式
// 1.直接一次识别单个音频文件（建议文件小一点识别更快）
test_MoonshineAsrOfflineRecognizer();
// 2.分片输入识别，适用于外接 vad
test_MoonshineAsrOnlineRecognizer();
// 3.流式输入识别，使用内置 vad 功能，自动断句，更加便捷
test_MoonshineAsrOnlineVadRecognizer(); </code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="etvu6DsP">内置 vad 功能相关操作（若使用）&nbsp;如果使用内置 vad 功能进行流式识别，还需下载 vad 模型，操作如下：</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">// 下载 vad 模型
cd /path/to/MoonshineAsr/MoonshineAsr.Examples
git clone https://www.modelscope.cn/manyeyes/alifsmnvad-onnx.git </code></pre>
</div>
<h2>三、代码调用方法</h2>
<h3>（一）离线（非流式）模型调用</h3>
<ol>
<li data-pid="O0XTESfS">添加项目引用&nbsp;在代码中添加以下引用：</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">using ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr;
using ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Model; </code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="yObsEnJH">模型初始化和配置：</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">string applicationBase = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
string modelName = "moonshine-base-en-onnx";
string preprocessFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/preprocess.int8.onnx";
string encodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/encode.int8.onnx";
string cachedDecodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/cached_decode.int8.onnx";
string uncachedDecodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/uncached_decode.int8.onnx";
string configFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/conf.json";
string tokensFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/tokens.txt";
OfflineRecognizer offlineRecognizer = new OfflineRecognizer(preprocessFilePath, encodeFilePath, cachedDecodeFilePath, uncachedDecodeFilePath, tokensFilePath, configFilePath: configFilePath, threadsNum: 1); </code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="VrWgbDqB">调用过程</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">List&lt;float[]&gt; samples = new List&lt;float[]&gt;();
//此处省略将 wav 文件转换为 samples 的相关代码，详细可参考 ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Examples 示例代码
List&lt;OfflineStream&gt; streams = new List&lt;OfflineStream&gt;();
foreach (var sample in samples)
{
    OfflineStream stream = offlineRecognizer.CreateOfflineStream();
    stream.AddSamples(sample);
    streams.Add(stream);
}
List&lt;OfflineRecognizerResultEntity&gt; results = offlineRecognizer.GetResults(streams); </code></pre>
</div>
<h3>（二）使用流式输入的方式调用模型进行识别</h3>
<ol>
<li data-pid="2camUpiz">添加项目引用&nbsp;同样在代码中添加以下引用：</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">using ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr;
 using ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Model; </code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="B7xRFWpr">模型初始化和配置</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">string applicationBase = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
string preprocessFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/preprocess.onnx";
string encodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/encode.onnx";
string cachedDecodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/cached_decode.onnx";
string uncachedDecodeFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/uncached_decode.onnx";
string tokensFilePath = applicationBase + "./" + modelName + "/tokens.txt";
string vadModelFilePath = applicationBase + "/" + vadModelName + "/" + "model.int8.onnx";
string vadMvnFilePath = applicationBase + vadModelName + "/" + "vad.mvn";
string vadConfigFilePath = applicationBase + vadModelName + "/" + "vad.json";
OnlineVadRecognizer onlineVadRecognizer = new OnlineVadRecognizer(preprocessFilePath, encodeFilePath, cachedDecodeFilePath, uncachedDecodeFilePath, tokensFilePath, vadModelFilePath, vadConfigFilePath, vadMvnFilePath, threadsNum: 1);

</code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="BoYjn0UK">调用过程</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">List&lt;float[]&gt; samples = new List&lt;float[]&gt;();
//此处省略将 wav 文件转换为 samples 的相关代码，以下是批处理示意代码：
List&lt;OnlineVadStream&gt; streams = new List&lt;OnlineVadStream&gt;();
foreach (var sample in samples)
{
    OnlineVadStream stream = onlineVadRecognizer.CreateOnlineVadStream();
    stream.AddSamples(sample);
    streams.Add(stream);
}
List&lt;OnlineRecognizerResultEntity&gt; results = onlineVadRecognizer.GetResults(streams);
//单处理示例，只需构建一个 stream
OnlineVadStream stream = onlineVadRecognizer.CreateOnlineVadStream();
stream.AddSamples(sample);
OnlineRecognizerResultEntity result = onlineVadRecognizer.GetResult(stream);
//具体可参考 ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Examples 示例代码

</code></pre>
</div>
<ol>
<li data-pid="e2fNYH5a">使用流式输入的方式识别，识别结果（自带时间戳）示例</li>
</ol>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">[00:00:00,630--&gt;00:00:06,790]
  thank you. Thank you.

[00:00:07,300--&gt;00:00:10,760]
 Thank you everybody. All right, everybody go ahead and have a seat.

[00:00:11,450--&gt;00:00:15,820]
 How's everybody doing today?

[00:00:17,060--&gt;00:00:20,780]
 How about Tim Spicer?

[00:00:24,270--&gt;00:00:30,450]
  I am here with students at Wakefield High School in Arlington, Virginia.

[00:00:31,070--&gt;00:00:40,430]
 And we've got students tuning in from all across America from kindergarten through 12th grade. And I am just so glad

[00:00:40,960--&gt;00:00:48,430]
 that all could join us today and I want to thank Wakefield for being such an outstanding host give yourselves a big round of applause

  // ...... (以下省略)</code></pre>
</div>
<h2>四、相关工程</h2>
<ul>
<li data-pid="ulPEqHsI">语音端点检测：为解决长音频合理切分问题，可添加 ManySpeech.AliFsmnVad 库，通过以下命令安装：</li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">dotnet add package ManySpeech.AliFsmnVad </code></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li data-pid="eaj-iKNQ">文本标点预测：针对识别结果缺乏标点的情况，可添加 ManySpeech.AliCTTransformerPunc 库，安装命令如下：</li>
</ul>
<div class="highlight">
<pre><code class="language-text">dotnet add package ManySpeech.AliCTTransformerPunc </code></pre>
</div>
<p data-pid="lOhbOBBN">具体的调用示例可参考对应库的官方文档或者&nbsp;<code>ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Examples</code>&nbsp;项目。该项目是一个控制台/桌面端示例项目，主要用于展示语音识别的基础功能，像离线转写、实时识别等操作。</p>
<h2>五、其他说明</h2>
<ul>
<li data-pid="sWnYdT1e">测试用例：以&nbsp;<code>ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr.Examples</code>&nbsp;作为测试用例。</li>
<li data-pid="r510_5zc">测试 CPU：使用的测试 CPU 为 Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz（2.59 GHz）。</li>
</ul>
<h2>六、模型下载（支持的 ONNX 模型）</h2>
<table data-draft-node="block" data-draft-type="table" data-size="normal" data-row-style="normal">
<tbody>
<tr><th>模型名称</th><th>类型</th><th>支持语言</th><th>标点</th><th>时间戳</th><th>下载地址</th></tr>
<tr>
<td>moonshine-base-en-onnx</td>
<td>非流式</td>
<td>英文</td>
<td>是</td>
<td>否</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>moonshine-tiny-en-onnx</td>
<td>非流式</td>
<td>英文</td>
<td>是</td>
<td>否</td>
<td><a class=" external" href="https://modelscope.cn/models/manyeyes/moonshine-tiny-en-onnx" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">modelscope.cn/models/ma<span class="invisible">nyeyes/moonshine-tiny-en-onnx</span></span></span></a></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2>七、模型介绍：</h2>
<ol>
<li data-pid="XPrhvZzB">模型定位差异</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li data-pid="JsIv_Z69">两个模型均为 Moonshine 系列的英文 ASR 模型，区别主要在于参数规模和性能：</li>
<ul>
<li data-pid="WeIAPmJE"><code>moonshine-tiny-en-onnx</code>：轻量级模型（27M 参数，约 190MB），适合资源受限的设备（如边缘设备、嵌入式设备），兼顾速度与基础识别精度。</li>
<li data-pid="EiyhvI94"><code>moonshine-base-en-onnx</code>：基础级模型（62M 参数，约 400MB），识别精度高于 Tiny 版本，适合对精度要求稍高、硬件资源较充足的场景。</li>
</ul>
<li data-pid="JXZmCMyS">模型下载方式<br>可通过 Git 命令直接克隆模型文件（需先安装 Git 工具），以&nbsp;<code>moonshine-tiny-en-onnx</code>&nbsp;为例：<br><code>git clone https://www.modelscope.cn/manyeyes/moonshine-tiny-en-onnx.git</code></li>
<li data-pid="D-aEsC8j">适配场景<br>两个模型均支持通过 ManySpeech.MoonshineAsr 库实现&nbsp;离线（非流式）语音识别，也可结合内置或外接的语音端点检测（VAD）模块（如 ManySpeech.AliFsmnVad）实现&nbsp;实时（流式）识别，适用于语音转写、实时字幕等场景。</li>

</ul>
<p data-pid="nhddfxCq">引用参考：</p>
<p data-pid="aEjMfmM7">[1]&nbsp;<a class=" external" href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=https%3A//github.com/usefulsensors/moonshine" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043"><span class="invisible">https://<span class="visible">github.com/usefulsensor</span></span></a></p>
</div>
